why: The two frames share the same room, light and composition, but image 2 has a denoised, painterly smear: the bar front's wood grain, the concrete wall and the floor go blotchy and waxy, which reads as a render. Image 1 keeps crisp material texture and an even, film-like grain, so the walnut, the concrete and the glass lamps hold up in crops as a real night photograph would.
